result.topic_en: Euler determines the possible prime divisors of a^n - b^n for composite n, especially of sums a^m + b^m (which must be of the form 2λm+1), with a table of such primes for m = 2 to 8, and gives a condition for divisibility of a^n - b^n by a prime mn+1.
result.transcription:
34 \quad L. EULERI OPERA POSTHUMA. \quad Arithmetica.

273. Si $n$ non sit numerus primus, sed productum duorum primorum, puta $n=\alpha\beta$, divisores primi formae $a^{\alpha\beta}-b^{\alpha\beta}$ praeter $a-b$ continentur in forma $2p+1$, existente $2p$ ad $\alpha\beta$ non primo, unde, prout vel $\alpha$, vel $\beta$, vel adeo $\alpha\beta$ fuerit maximus communis divisor, forma divisorum primorum erit vel $\lambda\alpha+1$, vel $\lambda\beta+1$, vel $\lambda\alpha\beta+1$, in quarum prima $\lambda$ non debet continere $\beta$, in secunda autem non $\alpha$, in tertia vero non limitatur.
274. At divisores formae $\lambda\alpha+1$ simul divident $a^{\alpha}-b^{\alpha}$, et divisores formae $\lambda\beta+1$ simul hanc $a^{\beta}-b^{\beta}$, siquidem in priore $\lambda$ sit numerus primus ad $\beta$, in posteriori autem ad $\alpha$.
275. Quare si formulae $a^{\alpha\beta}-b^{\alpha\beta}$ ii tantum divisores desiderentur, qui non simul dividant vel $a^{\alpha}-b^{\alpha}$, vel $a^{\beta}-b^{\beta}$, ii quaeri debent inter numeros primos formae $\lambda\alpha\beta+1$; sin autem tantum divisores formae $a^{\alpha}-b^{\alpha}$ excludere velimus, reliquos inter numeros primos $\lambda\beta+1$ quaerere debemus.
276. Sit $\alpha=2$ et $\beta=2$, atque omnes divisores primi hujus numeri $a^4-b^4$, qui non simul dividant $a^2-b^2$, continebuntur in forma $4\lambda+1$; hique ergo divisores erunt numeri $a^2+b^2$; unde patet numeros formae $a^2+b^2$ alios divisores primos non admittere, nisi qui sint formae $4\lambda+1$.
277. Sit $\alpha=3$ et $\beta=2$, atque omnes divisores primi numerorum $a^6-b^6$, qui non simul dividant $a^3-b^3$, continentur in forma $2\lambda+1$; qui autem insuper quoque non $a^2-b^2$ dividant, in hac $6\lambda+1$; hi ergo erunt divisores formae $a^2-ab+b^2$, neque tales numeri alios divisores agnoscunt.
278. Ex his in genere colligimus, si definiendi sint divisores numeri $a^{2m}-b^{2m}$, qui non simul sint divisores numeri $a^m-b^m$; hoc est, si desiderentur divisores numeri $a^m+b^m$, eos inter numeros primos hujus formae $2\lambda m+1$ quaeri oportere. Hinc autem excluditur divisor $a+b$, si $m$ sit numerus impar.
279. Ita pro variis valoribus ipsius $m$ faciamus hanc tabulam:

Numerorum formae | divisores quaeri debent inter numeros primos formae
$a^2+b^2$ | $4\lambda+1$ qui sunt 5, 13, 17, 29, 37, 41, 53, 61, 73, 89, 97
$a^3+b^3$ | $6\lambda+1$.........7, 13, 19, 31, 37, 43, 61, 67, 73, 79, 97
$a^4+b^4$ | $8\lambda+1$.........17, 41, 73, 89, 97, 113, 137, 193
$a^5+b^5$ | $10\lambda+1$.........11, 31, 41, 61, 71, 101, 131, 151, 181
$a^6+b^6$ | $12\lambda+1$.........13, 37, 61, 73, 97, 109, 157, 181, 193
$a^7+b^7$ | $14\lambda+1$.........29, 43, 71, 113, 127, 197, 211, 239
$a^8+b^8$ | $16\lambda+1$.........17, 97, 113, 193, 241, 257, 337
etc.

hic casus, ubi exponens est potestas binarii, prae reliquis sunt notandi, quia in reliquis generatim divisores assignari possunt. Tales ergo numeri $a^{2^n}+b^{2^n}$ alios divisores primos non habent, nisi qui in forma $2^{n+1}\lambda+1$ contineantur.
280. At $a^n-b^n$ dividi poterit per numerum primum $mn+1$, si numeri $a$ et $b$ ita fuerint comparati, ut $ax^m-by^m$ fiat divisibile per $mn+1$; dum scilicet pro $x$ et $y$ numeri assignari queant, quibus ista conditio adimpleatur, tum certe $a^n-b^n$ per $mn+1$ erit divisibilis.

methods.what: Prime divisors of a^{αβ}-b^{αβ} (other than a-b) have the form λα+1, λβ+1 or λαβ+1
methods.quote: forma divisorum primorum erit vel $\lambda\alpha+1$, vel $\lambda\beta+1$, vel $\lambda\alpha\beta+1$

methods.what: Primitive prime divisors of a^{αβ}-b^{αβ} lie among primes ≡1 mod αβ
methods.quote: ii quaeri debent inter numeros primos formae $\lambda\alpha\beta+1$

methods.what: Prime divisors of a^2+b^2 are of the form 4λ+1
methods.quote: numeros formae $a^2+b^2$ alios divisores primos non admittere, nisi qui sint formae $4\lambda+1$

methods.what: Prime divisors of a^2-ab+b^2 are of the form 6λ+1
methods.quote: hi ergo erunt divisores formae $a^2-ab+b^2$, neque tales numeri alios divisores agnoscunt

methods.what: Prime divisors of a^m+b^m not dividing a^m-b^m are of the form 2λm+1
methods.quote: si desiderentur divisores numeri $a^m+b^m$, eos inter numeros primos hujus formae $2\lambda m+1$ quaeri oportere

methods.what: Table of candidate primes 2λm+1 for a^m+b^m, m=2..8
Prime divisors of a^{2^n}+b^{2^n} are of the form 2^{n+1}λ+1
methods.quote: Tales ergo numeri $a^{2^n}+b^{2^n}$ alios divisores primos non habent, nisi qui in forma $2^{n+1}\lambda+1$ contineantur.

methods.what: Criterion: mn+1 prime divides a^n-b^n if ax^m-by^m is divisible by mn+1 for some x,y

items.quote: neque tales numeri alios divisores agnoscunt
items.english: and such numbers admit no other divisors.

items.quote: hic casus, ubi exponens est potestas binarii, prae reliquis sunt notandi, quia in reliquis generatim divisores assignari possunt
items.english: these cases, where the exponent is a power of two, are to be noted above the others, because in the others divisors can generally be assigned.

items.quote: dum scilicet pro $x$ et $y$ numeri assignari queant, quibus ista conditio adimpleatur, tum certe $a^n-b^n$ per $mn+1$ erit divisibilis
items.english: namely, whenever numbers can be assigned for x and y which fulfil this condition, then certainly a^n - b^n will be divisible by mn+1.
